Legitimate auto insurance does not require health information. This is characteristic of life insurance or health insurance underwriting, not auto insurance. This appears to be either a phishing site, a scam, or a fraudulent form misrepresenting its purpose. The domain 'quickquote-insure.com' combined with inappropriate health data collection suggests potential identity theft or fraud.
